title: Bhavani Ashtakam
intro: Bhavani Ashtakam is a sacred hymn dedicated to Goddess Bhavani. Read the complete Bhavani Ashtakam lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
Shrimad Aadi Shankaracharya Virachitam Bhavanyashtakam

na tato na mata na bandhurna data
na putro na putri na bhrtyo na bharta
na jaya na vidya na vrttirmamaiva
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 1 ||

bhavabdhavapare mahaduhkhabhiru
papata prakami pralobhi pramattah
kusamsarapasaprabaddhah sadaham
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 2 ||

na janami danam na cha dhyanayogam
na janami tantram na cha stotramantram
na janami pujam na cha nyasayogam
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 3 ||

na janami punyam na janami tirtham
na janami muktim layam va kadachit
na janami bhaktim vratam vapi matah
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 4 ||

kukarmi kukasangi kubuddhih kudasah
kulacharahinah kadacharalinah
kudrstih kuvakyaprabandhah sadaham
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 5 ||

prajesham ramesham mahesham suresham
dinesham nishitheshvaram va kadachit
na janami chanyat sadaham sharanye
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 6 ||

vivade vishade pramade pravase
jale chanale parvate shatrumadhye
aranye sharanye sada mam prapahi
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 7 ||

anatho daridro jararogayukto
mahakshinadeenah sada jadyavakhtrah
vipattau pravistah pranastah sadaham
gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani || 8 ||

|| Iti Shrimad Aadi Shankaracharya Virachitam Bhavanyashtakam Sampurnam ||

faq.a1: Bhavanyashtakam was composed by the great saint and founder of Advaita Vedanta, Adi Guru Shankaracharya.
faq.q2: What is the main purpose of Bhavanyashtakam?
faq.a2: The main purpose of this stotra is to express complete surrender and unwavering devotion towards Goddess Bhavani (Adi Shakti). It teaches us that all worldly relationships and attachments are temporary, and in times of distress, only the Divine Mother is our sole protector and refuge.
faq.q3: How many verses are there in Bhavanyashtakam?
faq.a3: As the name suggests, Bhavanyashtakam contains a total of 8 verses (ashtakam). Each verse ends with the line "gatistvam gatistvam tvameka bhavani".
faq.q4: What are the benefits of chanting Bhavanyashtakam?
faq.a4: Regular recitation brings mental peace, removes all types of sufferings, fears, diseases, and obstacles in life, and bestows happiness, prosperity, and positive energy through the grace of Goddess Bhagavati.
faq.q5: How and when should Bhavanyashtakam be recited?
faq.a5: It should be recited in the morning or evening after bathing with a pure mind, lighting a lamp in front of the picture or idol of Goddess Bhavani with complete devotion.
